description: This file defines template metaprogramming utilities for function traits, tuple manipulation, and index sequence generation within the c10::guts namespace, used for introspection and compile-time computations in PyTorch.

classes.name: function_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract return type and parameter types from function types.

classes.name: infer_function_traits
classes.description: Template struct to deduce function traits from functors, function pointers, and function types.

classes.name: make_function_traits
classes.description: Template struct to create function_traits from a return type and a typelist of argument types.

classes.name: make_offset_index_sequence_impl
classes.description: Implementation struct to generate an index sequence starting from a specified offset.

classes.name: TupleTake
classes.description: Template struct to extract first or last N elements from a tuple.

methods.name: tuple_elements
methods.description: Extracts a subset of elements from a tuple based on an index sequence.

methods.name: tuple_map
methods.description: Applies a mapping function to each element of a tuple, returning a new tuple.

methods.name: tuple_slice
methods.description: Extracts a contiguous subtuple from a tuple given a start index and length.

methods.name: tuple_take
methods.description: Extracts the first or last N elements from a tuple.
